subject: Virtual onsite schedule request — three-wave panels and quiet window

Subject: Scheduling Alicia Lopez — virtual onsite proposal

Hi team,

We have Alicia Lopez (applied for Software Engineer II) ready for a virtual onsite. She prefers mornings PST but is flexible if we provide a quiet window between interviews for a short break and buffer. Proposed structure: three waves (systems/depth, design, cross-functional/culture) with a 20–30 minute candidate quiet window between wave 1 and 2.

Proposed slots (PST):
- Wave 1 (systems): 9:00–10:10
- Quiet window: 10:10–10:40
- Wave 2 (design): 10:40–11:50
- Lunch/short break: 11:50–12:20
- Wave 3 (cross-functional + hiring manager): 12:20–13:30

Please confirm availability for Rishi, Mina and Olga (panel leads). I'll attempt to consolidate into a single calendar invite and attach the candidate resume and interview packet once we lock time.

Attachments: alopez_resume.pdf (sent by candidate), job-spec-SWII.pdf (internal)

Thanks,
Marissa

2) Request: please make the quiet window an uninterrupted 25 minutes (candidate asks for a short private moment) and mark it as "no-panel" in the calendar (no meeting links inside).
3) Rishi — can you confirm if 12:20 PST for HM + cross-functional works for you (I know you have a standing sync at noon that day). If not, we may need to shift the whole sequence 30 minutes later.

If everyone confirms, I'll draft the exact calendar blocks and the meeting notes template (questions + time allocation) and share.
